title: Add worker registry, queue limits and evidence reporting
description: Represent named worker configurations, enabled capabilities, health and active sessions. Prevent concurrent writers to the same workspace with an application-level workspace lease. Configure task queue/concurrency, elapsed-time and retry limits; distinguish this durable worker task queue from Mastra Signals’ per-thread input queue and notification inbox. Signals may route user prompts, worker updates and CI events to the workspace’s selected assistant thread, with bounded delivery/coalescing so event bursts do not flood runs. Do not treat Mastra thread ordering as a workspace-wide FIFO guarantee. Record provider-reported usage where available and mark unknown usage honestly. Show meaningful progress changes and final artifact/test evidence without flooding the conversation.
why: The assistant needs a trustworthy answer to who is working and whether the result is usable.

acceptance.text: A second write task waits for the first workspace lease
Worker unavailability is visible before dispatch
Timeout and cancellation release owned resources
A claimed success without required evidence stays unverified
